meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 它会诊断 NanoClaw 容器代理故障：先看主机日志，再查会话消息记录判断消息是否送达、有没有回复，随后检查挂载与心跳，排查重复运行、认证失败等故障并给出修复命令。
howto.when: 当容器相关功能出故障（如容器失败、认证问题），或你想了解容器系统怎么运作时触发。

say.text: 容器代理不回复，帮我查一下日志和会话消息记录。
say.note: Claude 会先查主机日志，再看消息到了没有。

say.text: 检查是不是有两个 NanoClaw 实例在运行。
say.note: Claude 会核对有没有重复的实例在抢消息。

say.text: NanoClaw 网关连不上，怎么排查？
say.note: Claude 会检查网关是否可达，以及认证信息是否注入。

howto.what_en: Follows the NanoClaw container debugging guide: checks host logs, session DBs for message arrival/replies, then mounts/heartbeat; diagnoses duplicate instances, auth failures and similar common issues, with fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when container agent issues occur, such as container failures or auth problems, or when the user wants to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Container agent isn't replying; check the logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Claude starts with host logs and session DBs.

say_en.text: Check whether two NanoClaw instances are running.
say_en.note: Claude checks running processes and service units.

say_en.text: Can't reach the NanoClaw gateway — how should I debug it?
say_en.note: Claude checks gateway reachability and secret injection.
